findings.title: The approved D03 repeated-evidence semantics are now directly enforced
findings.actual: Same-scope ASK_EVIDENCE is HTTP 200 with INTERVENE/E1/300; ASK_SAME_EVIDENCE remains display-only. A fully self-consistent in-memory regression to HTTP 400/P0 is rejected by the direct approval binding.

findings.title: The evaluate success Schema still accepts P0_PROHIBITED_ACTION/400 as DecisionResult data
findings.expected: The locked transport and firewall map every P0 result to HTTP 400 ApiEnvelope error with data=null; the evaluate success-data Schema must reject P0/400.
findings.actual: schemas/decision-result.schema.json still enumerates P0_PROHIBITED_ACTION and explicitly accepts rule_priority 400. An independently constructed INTERVENE/P0/400 success data object validates with zero errors.
reproduction: Run the independent probe and inspect the control named 'place P0_PROHIBITED_ACTION/400 inside evaluate success data'; actual is accepted.
findings.impact: A B or C implementation generated from the locked success Schema may legally emit HTTP 200 DecisionResult for a prohibited action, contradicting the approved HTTP boundary and bypassing the error-only P0 mapping.

findings.title: Consumer-facing next-update examples do not match the locked D08/A32 time contract
findings.expected: The Hero receipt uses the approved 10:30 next-update time, and a proactive notification's text contains the same next-update time as commits_next_update_at.
findings.actual: docs/04-responsibility-loop.md still says 10:27 in the consumer 'latest update' example although D08 locks 10:30. The shipment vector's three machine fields all equal 11:00, but its notification text contains no 11:00 time at all.
reproduction: Compare PRODUCT-FREEZE.md A32 and docs/05-api-and-ui.md:48 with tests/contract-vectors/shipment.json:100-101.
Run the independent probe; both D08 Hero receipt example and A32 notification text checks fail.
findings.impact: The contract handoff can lead C/BATCH-17 to show or test a different consumer promise than the machine deadline, defeating the single-time-source and notification-confirmation acceptance rule.

reproduction: Run the independent probe and inspect 'D03 vector fact_trace active_promise_count matches state snapshot'.
